text: The agent recommends coding this Dell Technologies invoice to 1540 Computer Hardware (cost centre CC4410) with 94.4% confidence, overriding the vendor default 6420 Repairs & Maintenance. 55 past invoices for these items were coded to 1540, while 6420 is used only for the ProSupport hardware service contract (5 invoices), and 3 past lines keyed to the default were reclassified at close an average of 40 days later. Note that policy required a PO for this IT hardware, so the invoice has been logged to the procurement non-compliance report. The 10 units ($20,009.03 incl. tax) are routed to Fixed Asset Accounting, which makes the capitalisation decision.
